steps.title: Ready
steps.caption: The presynaptic terminal and postsynaptic cell are separated by a synaptic cleft.

steps.title: Action potential
steps.caption: An action potential reaches the axon terminal and opens voltage-gated calcium channels.

steps.title: Release
steps.caption: Calcium entry triggers vesicle fusion and neurotransmitter release into the synaptic cleft.

steps.title: Receptor binding
steps.caption: Neurotransmitter crosses the cleft and binds a receptor on the postsynaptic membrane.

steps.title: Postsynaptic effect
steps.caption: An excitatory postsynaptic potential depolarizes the membrane: the inside becomes less negative.
